description.text: In the making of a great company, founders make all the big calls. And investors play the supporting roles. As prior founders ourselves, we started AppWorks to play that role. So you can count on our support. We love founders with passion, grit, and determination. We want to be the first investor to fund you and we want to help you go all the way.

Blog Wistron Accelerator By Founders, For Founders Helping tech startups disrupt the world since 2009 In the making of a great company, founders make all the big calls. And investors play the supporting roles. As prior founders ourselves, we started AppWorks to play that role. So you can count on our support. We love founders with passion, grit, and determination. We want to be the first investor to fund you and we want to help you go all the way. STATE OF THE APPWORKS NETWORK As of Q3 2026 680 ACTIVE STARTUPS 2,168 FOUNDERS 28,592 EMPLOYEES $ 8.2 B TOTAL RAISED $ 43.4 B TOTAL VALUATION $ 19.7 B ANNUAL REVENUES The Support We Provide AppWorks offers tailored support for founders across different stages of their journey. Through AppWorks Accelerator, we help early-stage startups find product-market fit and growth-stage startups expand across markets, with the resources, mentorship, and community to scale. For select startups, AppWorks Funds also provide capital to accelerate growth and long-term success. AppWorks Accelerator Started in 2010, AppWorks Accelerator helps early-stage startups find product-market fit and growth-stage startups expand across markets.
